title: "Download my data" says the file is saved even when the member closed the share sheet without saving it
what: After the backup file is made, the app opens the phone's share sheet. Whatever happens there, including closing it without picking Files, Drive or WhatsApp, the screen then says 'Saved mettleup-backup-....zip'. The file is only in the app's own temporary folder and is deleted at the next save, so a member can believe they have a backup that does not exist outside the app.
expected: The words say the file is ready to be saved and where to look, or 'Saved' appears only when the member chose a place.
how_often: every time the share sheet is closed without a choice
fix_line: Change the line after the share sheet to say the file was handed over, not saved
